title: No published operation name for the rwb-source-data appraisal and asset product, for the rwb-case case-state read or for the case-move answer
source: Architecture v5 slide 8; Ownership Map; TSD S5 T5.2 and T-A.1
section: s3 Preconditions; s12.2 REST operations consumed
description: The below-floor accept step reads the appraisal and NPA asset facts (v_ace_valuation and v_ace_npa_asset in the legacy) and answers the case moves SECOND_SIGNATURE_PENDING and SALE_AGREED. No source document publishes the operation name of the rwb-source-data data-product read, of the rwb-case case-state read or of the case-move answer, and the C row of this slice in the plan is None.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-025 Endpoints table names only POST /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId}/listings and GET /api/recovery/v1/assets; TSD S5 T5.2 says calls go through published Java interfaces without an operation name; the Ownership Map lists no source-data product, case-state or case-move operation.
proposed: Declare the three rows with the placeholder and their gap identifier, build against the documented shapes and their fakes on Day 1, and let P1 and P3 publish the names at the tag of RWB-S5-E4025-CON.

title: No S5 field holds the bid amount or the second signature that R-DIS-41 and R-DIS-42 condition on
source: TSD S5 T3.1 and T3.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-41 and R-DIS-42; FSD S5 A2.16.3
description: R-DIS-41 is conditioned on bid_amount below floor_price and R-DIS-42 on second_signature_by present, but the listing object of TSD S5 T3.1 carries id, asset_id, sale_channel, start_price, floor_price, round_no, listed_at and status only, and asset_sale carries the sale fields only. No source names a table, a column or a reference-data row that holds the bid, its bidder or the signature, and the approval record is P7's `approval`.
evidence: TSD S5 T3.1 listing DF-SAL-001 to DF-SAL-008 and asset_sale DF-SAL-009 to DF-SAL-019; the two rule conditions in the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4; FSD S5 A2.16.3.2 field catalog lists only the v_ace_* asset fields.
proposed: Hold the bid against the round row the rounds story owns, read the signature from the rwb-decision approval, add no column to rwb_asset, and keep the elements as the placeholder until the LDM names them.

title: The legacy endpoints table names the listings write for the accept while the TSD gives the round write the sale answer
source: TSD S5 T-A.1 and T-A.2; FSD S5 A2.16; legacy RWB-E4-025 Endpoints; Template and Rules v1 R3
section: s7 Acceptance criteria; s12.1 REST operations provided
description: Legacy RWB-E4-025 lists POST /assets/{assetId}/listings as its write, which TSD S5 T-A.2 documents as setting the list price and the floor and answering with an Approval. The action the story describes is the accept of a bid, and the only operation whose documented answer is the AssetSale is POST /listings/{listingId}/rounds (API-S5-005), which is also the rounds story's of RWB-E4-024. No source says which operation carries the accept or which story baselines the round write.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-025 Endpoints table; TSD S5 T-A.2 API-S5-004 purpose and response, and API-S5-005 purpose and response; API Specification v4 /listings/{listingId}/rounds returns AssetSale with right U.
proposed: Take the TSD over the story master under §R3: declare API-S5-005 once for the rounds story and this accept, and let the two baselines agree the posted fields at the tag.

title: No published operation raises the second-signature approval item, and no S5 field carries its outcome
source: API Specification v4 /approvals; Architecture v5 slides 12 and 13; FSD S5 A2.16
section: s3 Preconditions; s12.5 Workflows and activities
description: R-DIS-41 routes a below-floor bid for a second signature owned by the Committee on the Committee View with a two-working-day clock, and the approval record is P7's `approval`. The API Specification publishes GET /approvals and POST /approvals/{approvalId}/approve, return and refuse, but no operation that creates an approval item, and no source says whether the request is raised by the workflow kit's approval child on rwb-decision's queue or by a REST operation.
evidence: API Specification v4 /approvals has get only, with the item creation carried by operations that answer with an Approval; Architecture v5 slide 12 lists Approval for S2, S3 and S5 to S7 approvals; TSD S5 T5.2 and A2.16 name no approval operation.
proposed: Raise the item with the workflow kit's approval child on rwb-decision's queue, declare the item's elements as a reference in the baseline and add no REST row for the request.

title: The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice
source: Plan draft of the run; FSD S5 A2.16; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 feature row FEAT-AST-16
description: The story rows of this slice carry an empty requirement list, so the slice traces to the feature FEAT-AST-16 and to the FSD section only, and the header requires the PRD reference to read Pending (C1).
evidence: Story rows of RWB-S5-E4025-APP and RWB-S5-E4025-CON with reqs []; FSD S5 T8 lists REQ-S5-001 to REQ-S5-010 against other features only and no epic BRD for Epics 3 to 8 is available.
proposed: Trace the slice to FEAT-AST-16 of the Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 and FSD S5 A2.16 until the PRD allocates requirement ids.

title: The step evaluates a DISPOSAL rule package and uses the approval template while neither carries a pattern row of this slice
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04; story row patterns DP03, DP05, DP13, DP19; TSD S5 T4; Architecture v5 slide 12
description: R-DIS-41, R-DIS-42 and R-DIS-17 are evaluated against the DISPOSAL rule package, which DP-04 governs with H RWB-PLT-E1072-CON and C RWB-P7-E1073-CON, and the second signature runs on the workflow kit's approval template. The pattern set of the slice names neither, and no source says whether the package load and the approval template are capabilities of the service template or patterns of this slice.
evidence: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04 row; the patterns of RWB-S5-E4025-APP; Architecture v5 slide 12 WHERE S1-S9 USE THE KIT; FSD S5 A2.16.3.1 rule table.
proposed: Load the package in force and run the approval on the platform templates of the service, add no H row for the rules kit in this slice, and record the reading so the next realignment of the pattern set can confirm it.
